integrity: The extremal two-state bound and a realizing pair are previously known and are credited; finite tests corroborate a separate all-n proof; no independent scientific audit is claimed.
limitations: Two-state merging in the specifically labeled Cerny family only; no assertion about arbitrary automata, general k-set rendezvous, longer merging words, or total reset thresholds. Gusev 2014 explicitly presents the odd-state pair transition graph, which creates a residual risk of an implicit equivalent statement.
title: Exact pair-merging distances and unique shortest-word suffixes in Černý automata
